explanation: The AI response correctly includes 12 of the 13 required states. It missed Mississippi. Additionally, it included Nebraska, which was an excessive answer because Nebraska split its electoral votes in 2020 (NE-02 went to Biden) and thus did not have *all* of its electoral votes go to Trump.
